# Metaphysics as a Guide to Morals

*[Iris Murdoch](../philosophers/iris-murdoch.md) · 1992*

Grown out of her Gifford Lectures (Edinburgh, 1982), this long book takes up her whole thought: consciousness and inner life, the Good without God, the ontological argument reread, art, politics and a critique of structuralism.
